verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator: physics, rendering, sensors, plugins and simulation tooling. Over-the-air software deployment to physical robot fleets, with staged rollouts and rollback, belongs to a different product category (fleet management/DevOps). Nothing in the evidence shows Gazebo ships any deployment capability, so this is a wrong-axis question rather than a missing feature.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can deploy software updates over-the-air to robots with staged rollouts and rollback
